ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: OGRE OpenGL support library, Wayland flavour: context and window creation through EGL on Wayland
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The sources of OgreGLSupport (the directory GLSupport) built with the EGL window system of Wayland instead of X11 (OGRE_WAYLAND, the upstream option OGRE_USE_WAYLAND), for the Wayland flavours of the OpenGL render systems. Ogre 1.x chooses X11 or Wayland when it is compiled; render windows of this flavour take externalWlDisplay and externalWlSurface. The module lists the sources of the other directory in its ProjectGenInstructions.xml.
